description.value: A converted former guest house for Highland Valley Copper Mines, this 4,700-square-foot bungalow sits on 25 acres just outside Logan Lake in BC's Highland Valley. With four en-suite bedrooms and a hot tub, it caters to outdoor enthusiasts drawn to the area's fishing, ATV trails, and horseback riding — they even offer equine experiences on-site. Logan Lake is located south of Kamloops via Hwy 97C, making it a potential stop for cyclists traversing the Interior.

address.value: 8615 Tunkwa Lake Road, Logan Lake, V0K 1W0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active B&B with 4 bedrooms on 25 acres near Logan Lake. Wi-Fi is confirmed via 'Free Wifi available' on the amenities list.
